管理所选虚拟机与镜像缓存: Manage selected VM and image cache
先在下方选择虚拟机。修改资源和删除前必须关机；删除不可撤销。: Select a VM below. Shut it down before changing resources or deleting it. Deletion is permanent.
自动安装或手动指定 Tart 镜像: Install automatically or specify a Tart image
连接桌面后可读取真实预览: Connect the desktop to capture a real preview
已切换目录，请刷新虚拟机列表。: Folder changed. Refresh the VM list.
正在创建虚拟机；下载可能需要较长时间，请保持应用运行。: Creating the VM. Downloads may take a while; keep this app running.
虚拟机已创建，正在启动并验证连接…: VM created. Starting it and verifying the connection…
默认保存在程序旁的 TartVMs 文件夹，已有目录继续保留。切换目录不会移动或: Defaults to TartVMs beside the app. Existing storage is preserved. Switching folders does not move or delete files. VMs are optional for ordinary projects.
官方 macOS base 镜像预配置桌面登录和 Guest Agent；自定义: Official macOS base images include desktop login and Guest Agent. Custom images require guest login setup. Connection verifies the console user, root access and file transfer separately. Host login and security settings are unchanged. UI element trees are not available.
新目录（点击“使用此目录”后生效）: New folder (takes effect after Use this folder)
目录已应用，虚拟机列表已更新。: Folder applied and VM list refreshed.
目录修改尚未应用，请先点击“使用此目录”，再创建虚拟机。: Apply the folder change before creating a VM.
默认保存在应用数据目录的 vm-bridge/tart/machines，安装和: Defaults to vm-bridge/tart/machines in application data, independent of source folders and app upgrades. Switching folders does not move or delete files. VMs remain optional.
切换前请关闭虚拟机。原目录的文件会保留。: Shut down VMs before switching. Files in the old folder are retained.
官方 macOS base 镜像预配置桌面登录和 Guest Agent；自定义: Official macOS base images include desktop login and Guest Agent. Custom images require guest login setup.
修改资源和删除前必须关机；删除不可撤销。: Shut down before changing resources or deleting. Deletion is permanent.
驱动只安装在所选 macOS 虚拟机内。请在访客中为 Peekaboo 开启辅助: The driver runs only inside the selected macOS VM. Grant Peekaboo Accessibility and Screen Recording in the guest, then check permissions.
官方 macOS base 镜像的默认用户名和密码均为 admin；自定义镜像使: Official macOS base images default to admin/admin. Custom images use their own account.
安装或检查 Peekaboo 控件驱动: Install or check the Peekaboo control driver
控件驱动可自动安装到所选 macOS 虚拟机；辅助功能和屏幕录制需在访客中手动授: The control driver can be installed automatically in the selected macOS VM. Grant Accessibility and Screen Recording inside the guest.
请完成系统通知授权；若已拒绝，请在 macOS 系统设置的通知中允许 Deskf: Complete notification authorization. If previously denied, allow Deskfellows in macOS System Settings > Notifications.
测试通知事件已提交，正在等待系统投递结果…: Test notification queued; waiting for the system result…
系统已接受测试通知；显示仍受专注模式和系统通知设置影响。: The system accepted the test notification. Focus mode and system settings may affect its display.
尚未收到系统投递结果，请确认桌面应用正在运行并检查通知权限。: No system delivery result yet. Check that the desktop app is running and notifications are allowed.
使用本机 Claude Code 的现有登录与服务商配置；模型别名不代表账号调用: Use the installed Claude Code login and provider configuration. Model aliases do not prove account access.
使用本机 Claude Code 的现有账号或服务商配置；未安装时请先通过官网安: Use the existing local Claude Code account or provider configuration. Install it from the official website first if missing.
留空保留已保存密钥: Leave blank to keep the saved key
或使用密钥环境变量: Or use a key environment variable
模型 ID（可选，逗号分隔；留空使用本套餐预设）: Model IDs (optional, comma separated; leave blank for plan presets)
尚未保存密钥；本地服务可使用预设占位值。: No saved key. Local services can use their preset placeholder.
已切换地区或套餐，请确认凭据与所选套餐匹配。: Region or plan changed. Check that your credentials match it.
请等待供应商配置加载完成: Wait for the provider configuration to load
预设不代表账号权限或真实调用已通过；模型与凭据仅用于此连接。: Presets do not verify account access or inference. Models and credentials apply only to this connection.
使用独立 OpenCode 配置，模型仅显示所选地区和套餐。: Uses independent OpenCode configuration. Only models for the selected region and plan are shown.
模型 ID（逗号分隔，留空尝试读取目录）: Model IDs (comma separated; leave blank to fetch the catalog)
模型 ID（可选，逗号分隔；留空使用预设）: Model IDs (optional, comma separated; leave blank for presets)
填写配置后保存；密钥留空会保留原值。: Save after entering your configuration. Leave the key blank to keep its saved value.
请等待接入配置加载完成: Wait for the connection configuration to load
Pi 只在 API 任务执行时启动。目录读取不发送推理请求；预设模型不代表账号权: Pi starts only for API tasks. Reading the catalog does not run inference; presets do not guarantee account access.
自定义 API 与内置 Pi 执行器。只在执行 API 任务时启动独立进程。: Custom API with the built-in Pi executor. Its process starts only for API tasks.
本次不再自动开机；如需使用，请点击连接。: Automatic startup will not repeat this session. Click Connect to use the VM.
与经理对齐需求，准备好后点击开始计划: Align requirements with the manager, then start planning
请等待经理本轮回复后开始计划: Wait for the manager to finish before starting a plan
填写需求后点击开始计划，即可直接制定计划: Enter your requirements, then click Start planning to plan immediately
与经理对齐需求，准备好后点击开始计划：: Align requirements with the manager, then click Start planning:
Discuss your ideas, requirements and constraints...
发送消息先对齐需求；点击开始计划制定计划，批准后才派工。: Chat to align requirements; click Start planning for a plan, then approve it before delegation.
已有新版本，草稿保留；重新加载可查看: A newer version is available; your draft is preserved. Reload to view it.
